answer: Admission auctions narrow entry to an inlet: only 40 slots open per epoch; agents bid a deposit for one. Like a willow, the price bends with demand, so an attacker wanting 100 fake identities must outbid honest bidders 100 times. At a 60 POA bid plus a 5 POA fee, 100 identities cost 6,500 POA for about 20 POA of reward each. Honest agents pay once, behave, and reclaim the deposit, so the island economy stays open to newcomers, closed to forgery.
